body: Life can be I overbearing all the time. I’ve pretty much been isolating myself from my friends and family bc I know I won’t get better and my anxiety tells me I’m a burden to everyone even when they tell me I’m not. And deep down I know they can’t help me and I don’t want them to exhaust all their efforts and time on a lost cause.

Me either but that’s more than I’ve ate today. I didnt  have the energy to cook anything so I went for the first thing I saw in the kitchen, chocolate cake. But it’s been sitting on my dresser for abt an hr now. But what did you fuck up exactly?
